message: ふたり

name: Azel
message: 「From now on...... just like this, together with Synn......」

name: Azel
message: 「The two of us will be able to do all sorts of things together, won't we......」

name: Synn
message: 「Me, and Azel......」

name: Synn
message: 「Because from now on, the two of us will always be together」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure we can do anything」

name: Synn
message: 「Making more friends, taking photos......」

name: Synn
message: 「Even kissing like this......」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...... I love you」

name: Azel
message: 「I love you too, Synn......」
Our parted lips became one for longer than ever before.
And our hearts finally joined together as one.
That sensation was so warm and comforting.
Almost as if it were blessing our future......

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, what on earth is it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nuhuhu......」

name: Macaron
message: 「A thoughtful little gesture from me, just for you, Big Brother」

name: Paqy
message: 「This time, I'm gonna explain all about the little squirt's Extra Attack!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aaaah?!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, Panda-chan! Don't go stealing my lines!」

name: Paqy
message: 「No need to be such a stickler about it」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now」

name: Synn
message: 「Cheer up and tell me about yourself, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez... Well, I guess I have no choice!」

name: Macaron
message: 「As a special treat, I'll explain my Extra Attacks to you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, you already know I have two kinds of Extra Attacks, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. They've given me plenty of grief before, after all」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi. The first is my special move, 'Burn Comet Splash'!」

name: Macaron
message: 「While dealing damage to the target, it adds wait time to them based on my Magic Lv」

name: Paqy
message: 「So chanting or whatever boosts the effect of pushing the enemy back, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, I see」

name: Macaron
message: 「And the other is my super special move, 'Legionic Weaver'!」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's a super-duper support skill that massively boosts all allies' Magic Lv and Base Attack!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sounds kinda dirty」

name: Macaron
message: 「My spirit is always fair and square!」

name: Macaron
message: 「By the way, the effect lasts until each ally's Symbol finishes attacking, though be careful since it doesn't stack!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gotcha...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just like with the angel, you use 'em by selecting a button」

name: Macaron
message: 「Whichever one you pick, my strength stays the same though!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, if you combine these two Extra Attacks together...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... You'll just have to try it out to see how powerful it is!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Macaron
message: 「That covers the basic explanation, but...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wanna review this tutorial again?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Really?」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, I'll team up with Macaron and fight!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi. Not that I even need your help or anything, big brother」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hold it right theeeere!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's the big idea all of a sudden, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well... there's actually just one more... major secret to EX Attacks」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp... W-what could that be...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Take my word for it. Just shut up and pick 'Yes' on the next prompt!」
View the battle tutorial "Attacking with EX Attacks: Part 2"?

name: Paqy
message: 「So that pretty much covers the basics, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hold on a sec, Paqy-chan. There's still more left, right」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, right, that」

name: Ria
message: 「The deeper secret of EX... right♪」

name: Synn
message: 「W-what on earth is it... My heart's pounding」

name: Ria
message: 「What do you wanna do? Wanna listen to 'Attacking with EX Attacks: Part 2' too?」

name: Ria
message: 「Then, wanna review the tutorial from just now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. Let's do our best!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, what exactly is the secret of EX Attacks?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Listen and be amazed. Believe it or not, EX Attacks actually--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, what is this! When I chant, the destructive power is insane!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, knock it ooooff! Don't go spoiling it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Well, chanting boosts attack power too, so isn't that normal?」

name: Ria
message: 「Bzzzt, wrong answer~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh man, you've gotta be kidding me」

name: Ria
message: 「When you chant, the effect of your EX Attack increases even further, making it way, wa~y stronger!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it works?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The skill added for me is an upgraded version of 'Raging Nova' called 'Volcane Melt Swarm'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not only does the damage dealt go up, it also instantly destroys barriers so you can deal damage right away」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Barriers? What are those?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Stronger enemies might start showing up from here on out. For now, just keep that tucked away in the back of your mind」

name: Ria
message: 「In the same way, Misa-chan gets a power-up too♪」

name: Misa
message: 「For me, 'Noblesse Laser' is upgraded to become 'Dimensional Wave'」

name: Misa
message: 「Which means I am now able to reduce the enemy's STUN Gauge even more than before」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ho-ho. With this, the enemies will be having a dizzy-bird festival」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's 'Cardinal Brightia' gets stronger and becomes 'Exect Divinity'」

name: Paqy
message: 「On top of its original effect of reducing the EX Gauge, it absorbs a portion of the gauge it reduces」

name: Ria
message: 「Be careful though, because you can't absorb any portion that puts the opponent's EX Gauge into the negatives」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How terrifying!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That about covers the EX Attacks that get powered up by chanting, though...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ba-dump, ba-dump...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte's and mine are still--」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan's EX Attack is, well! A liiittle bit different from everyone else's!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Paqy
message: 「An angel's EX Attack is a special kind that you can switch between depending on the situation」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, it can be activated under the exact same conditions as my original 'Seraphic Whisper', correct?」

name: Ria
message: 「The new EX Attack Lolotte-chan can use is 'Absolute Tears'」

name: Ria
message: 「It lets you put up a special barrier that nullifies damage and STUN Gauge reduction a set number of times」

name: Paqy
message: 「Since it's different from your usual healing effect, you'll need to choose wisely which one to use」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. Then, how exactly can one differentiate between them?」

name: Paqy
message: 「When the EX Ring pops up, you push the button!」

name: Ria
message: 「'Double push...'」

name: Paqy
message: 「The skill name shows up as a guide alongside the EX Ring, so look at that and make your call」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. So in Lolotte's case, the 'Circle Button' and 'Cross Button' correspond to healing, while the 'Triangle Button' and 'Square Button' correspond to barriers」

name: Paqy
message: 「There are also other characters who can use up to four types of EX Attacks, but they don't show up this time, so we'll skip 'em」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, really. Now, what about my EX--」

name: Paqy
message: 「And with that~」

name: Ria
message: 「That's all for Ria and Paqy's Tutorial Corner!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hold on!! I don't get anything!?」

name: Ria
message: 「A-ahaha... Well, that's, um~~\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn's EX Attack is way too strong to begin with」

name: Synn
message: 「Right now, only Paqy shows up for me, though」

name: Ria
message: 「How strong you become, Synn, all depends on your future efforts... right♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Then I'll do my best!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Love the positivity」

name: Ria
message: 「That covers everything, but...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wanna review this tutorial one more time?」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you sure?」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. Delicious Food Squad... prepare yourselves」

name: Sally
message: 「Yaaawn... Ngah... Is it finally my turn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Were you asleep?!」
